about_the_game:
Warning: This game contains flashing lights that may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy. Play with caution.

What if the house remembered every step you took?

You’re not alone. You can’t see it, but it’s listening.

CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned house that reacts to your actions. There are no cheap jumpscares — the horror comes from the environment, from the recordings you uncover, and from the silence that grows heavier with every step.

Discover its story by listening to real cassette tapes, recorded by human voices, and face an atmosphere that transforms based on what you do... or what you ignore.

Why you should play

  • Narrative horror focused on atmosphere, inspired by ANATOMY and PT

  • Fragmented storytelling through disturbing audio tapes

  • The environment reacts to your presence — no two experiences are the same

  • Ideal for a single, short, intense session (1 to 2 hours)

  • Designed to be played with headphones, in the dark, without distractions

You wake up in a damp basement, with a strange echo reverberating through the walls. You don’t know how you got here. But you're not alone.

The house isn’t just a setting. It remembers. It changes when you look away. Sometimes, it wants to speak to you. Sometimes, it wants you to leave. But above all… it seems to be waiting for something.

As you move through shifting rooms, you find abandoned cassette tapes containing unsettling recordings. Through these voices of the past, the story reveals itself in fragments, like an open wound that never healed. What you hear isn’t always trustworthy. What you see, even less so.

CoRoT marks the beginning of a cosmic horror universe, built on doubt, silence, and isolation.
This isn’t about surviving — it’s about understanding… if you can.

content_descriptors.notes: CoRoT features descriptions of murders and subtle hints of torture conveyed through audio and text. Additionally, players may encounter corpses or fragments of them, along with blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game. Search for cassettes in a transforming house, unraveling its macabre past. A sinister atmosphere surrounds you as you try to understand what's happening and where you really are. Can you discover the truth hidden in its walls?
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Russian
*languages with full audio support
